description: Steakhouse USDT is an immutable MetaMorpho (v1) ERC4626 vault, curated by Steakhouse Financial, that supplies depositor USDT into a curated set of Morpho Blue lending markets ({{vaultPositions}} currently deployed across wstETH, WBTC, BTC, gold, ETH, DAI and cbBTC collateral). A 5-of-8 owner multisig holds the powerful roles (fee, curator, guardian, ownership) while a 2-of-6 curator multisig sets per-market caps and queues; all caps and timelock/guardian changes are gated by a 7-day timelock. An Aragon OSx DAO of vault depositors acts as guardian and can veto pending changes. Collateral pricing depends entirely on Chainlink feeds read through Morpho Blue.

eth:0x0A0e559bc3b0950a7e448F0d4894db195b.name: Owner (5-of-8 Multisig)
eth:0x0A0e559bc3b0950a7e448F0d4894db195b.description: Holds every owner-gated role on the vault: setFee (capped at 50% of yield), setCurator, setIsAllocator, setFeeRecipient, setSkimRecipient, submitTimelock, submitGuardian, and transferOwnership/renounceOwnership. Can also submit and accept market caps. transferOwnership and renounceOwnership are uncapped and critical; all parameter changes flow through the 7-day timelock and can be vetoed by the guardian. Reaches {{ownerCapital}} of vault capital.

eth:0x827e86072B06674a077f592A531dcE4590.name: Curator (2-of-6 Multisig)
eth:0x827e86072B06674a077f592A531dcE4590.description: Steakhouse Financial curator multisig. Submits/removes per-market supply caps (submitCap, submitMarketRemoval) and manages the supply/withdraw queues and reallocation. Cap and market-removal changes are 7-day timelocked and guardian-vetoable; reallocation can only move funds into markets that already have a non-zero cap. Reaches {{curatorCapital}} of vault capital, bounded by per-market caps.

eth:0xfeed46c11F57B7126a773EeC6ae9cA7aE1.name: Allocator (EOA)
eth:0xfeed46c11F57B7126a773EeC6ae9cA7aE1.description: Allocator EOA that can call setSupplyQueue, updateWithdrawQueue and reallocate. These only rebalance funds across markets that already have a curator-approved cap, so the role carries no direct fund-extraction power (scored no-impact).

eth:0x29d4CDFee8F533af8529A9e1517b580E02.name: Allocator (1-of-5 Multisig)
eth:0x29d4CDFee8F533af8529A9e1517b580E02.description: Secondary allocator multisig with the same reallocation-only powers (setSupplyQueue, updateWithdrawQueue, reallocate). Bounded by existing per-market caps; no direct fund-extraction power (scored no-impact).

eth:0xaeC761545Fd135db6d04D27C92BCB39516.name: Guardian (Aragon OSx DAO)
eth:0xaeC761545Fd135db6d04D27C92BCB39516.description: Aragon OSx guardian DAO whose voting power is held by vault depositors proportional to their deposit. Its only powers are vetoes (revokePendingTimelock, revokePendingGuardian, revokePendingCap, revokePendingMarketRemoval) executed during the 7-day timelock window. It cannot move funds or initiate changes, but its veto reach spans the entire vault ({{guardianCapital}}); a compromised or inactive guardian removes the depositor backstop against malicious owner/curator submissions.

eth:0xBBBBBbbBBb9cC5e90e3b3Af64bdAF62C37.name: Morpho Blue
eth:0xBBBBBbbBBb9cC5e90e3b3Af64bdAF62C37.description: The Morpho Blue singleton lending protocol. The vault supplies all depositor USDT into permissionless Morpho markets and holds its entire {{vaultPositions}} as supply positions here. Bad-debt accounting and liquidations on Morpho Blue directly determine whether the vault's positions are recoverable.

eth:0xfd32fA2ca22c76dD6E550706Ad913FC6CE.name: Morpho PublicAllocator
eth:0xfd32fA2ca22c76dD6E550706Ad913FC6CE.description: Shared Morpho allocator the curator has whitelisted as an allocator, letting third parties rebalance liquidity across the vault's markets within curator-set flow caps. No direct fund-extraction power.

eth:0x9E9110cFd24cd851ea5bc73a27975B33E3.name: MorphoHelper
eth:0x9E9110cFd24cd851ea5bc73a27975B33E3.description: Morpho periphery helper contract whitelisted as an allocator; used for reallocation across the vault's markets, bounded by existing per-market caps.

eth:0xF4030086522a5bEEa4988F8cA5B36dbC97.name: Chainlink BTC / USD Feed
eth:0xF4030086522a5bEEa4988F8cA5B36dbC97.description: Chainlink BTC/USD price feed used by the oracle adapters of the vault's BTC-collateral markets. A manipulated or stale value could misprice those markets and enable bad debt up to their deployed supply.

eth:0xc0053f3FBcCD593758258334Dfce24C2A9.name: Chainlink ETH / USD Feed
eth:0xc0053f3FBcCD593758258334Dfce24C2A9.description: Chainlink ETH/USD price feed feeding the ETH-denominated collateral markets via their MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 adapters.

eth:0x4F67e4d9BD67eFa28236013288737D39Ae.name: wstETH / ETH Price Feed
eth:0x4F67e4d9BD67eFa28236013288737D39Ae.description: Custom wstETH/ETH exchange-rate price feed (built on Chainlink) used to price the wstETH-collateral markets.

eth:0xEe9F2375b4bdF6387aa8265dD4FB8F1651.name: Chainlink USDT / ETH Feed
eth:0xEe9F2375b4bdF6387aa8265dD4FB8F1651.description: Chainlink USDT/ETH price feed used as a quote feed in the wstETH market oracle stack.

eth:0x3E7d1eAB13ad0104d2750B8863b489D653.name: Chainlink USDT / USD Feed
eth:0x3E7d1eAB13ad0104d2750B8863b489D653.description: Chainlink USDT/USD price feed used as the quote feed across several of the vault's market oracle adapters.

eth:0xfdFD9C85aD200c506Cf9e21F1FD8dd0193.name: Chainlink WBTC / BTC Feed
eth:0xfdFD9C85aD200c506Cf9e21F1FD8dd0193.description: Chainlink WBTC/BTC proof-of-reserve-style price feed combined with BTC/USD to price WBTC collateral.

eth:0xAed0c38402a5d19df6E4c03F4E2DceD6e2.name: Chainlink DAI / USD Feed
eth:0xAed0c38402a5d19df6E4c03F4E2DceD6e2.description: Chainlink DAI/USD price feed used by the DAI-collateral market's oracle adapter.

eth:0x2665701293fCbEB223D11A08D826563EDc.name: Chainlink cbBTC / USD Feed
eth:0x2665701293fCbEB223D11A08D826563EDc.description: Chainlink cbBTC/USD price feed used inside the MetaOracleDeviationTimelock-wrapped cbBTC market oracle.

eth:0x91D32e6f01d6473b596f54c6E304e06d77.name: Chainlink BTC / USD Feed (deviation-wrapped)
eth:0x91D32e6f01d6473b596f54c6E304e06d77.description: Chainlink BTC/USD price feed consumed inside the MetaOracleDeviationTimelock primary/current oracle; the deviation guard adds a delay before large price moves are accepted.

eth:0x214eD9Da11D2fbe465a6fc601a91E62EbE.name: Chainlink XAU / USD Feed
eth:0x214eD9Da11D2fbe465a6fc601a91E62EbE.description: Chainlink gold (XAU/USD) price feed for the vault's single gold-collateral market. That market's supply cap is the lowest in the vault, so a failure of this feed is bounded to a small fraction of total vault TVS rather than the full deposit base.

eth:0x21f73D42Eb58Ba49dDB685dc29D3bF5c0f.name: Chainlink Feed Admin (Multisig)
eth:0x21f73D42Eb58Ba49dDB685dc29D3bF5c0f.description: Owner multisig of the Chainlink aggregator proxies; can repoint the underlying aggregators. Operated by Chainlink, outside the vault's or curator's control.

eth:0xbEef047a543E45807105E51A8BBEFCc595.name: Steakhouse USDT Vault (USDT)
eth:0xbEef047a543E45807105E51A8BBEFCc595.description: Holds {{vaultPositions}} of depositor USDT supplied into Morpho Blue lending markets across wstETH, WBTC, BTC, gold, ETH, DAI and cbBTC collateral. This is the vault's entire TVS.
